== The Drow Faction ==
[[File:Drow champion trophy.png|left|Drow Champion Trophy]]
[[File:Perfect Combo.png|right|Perfect Combo]]
'''Drow''' were implemented during the [[Updates#1.2 The Underworld|Underworld]] expansion (v1.2). It is the Evil [[Prestige Factions|Prestige Faction]], and will only appear when playing an Evil [[Vanilla faction]]. The Drow player will be able to combine the 2 faction spells and all the 18 upgrades and from both the Evil Vanilla and Drow factions. Several of their upgrades rely on [[Royal Exchanges]] and it is suggested to combine with the faction-coin-heavy [[Goblin Faction]] (forming something popularly referred to as "Droblins").

* '''[[Alignment]]''': '''''Prestige''''' (Evil)
* '''[[Spells|Faction Spell]]''': '''''Combo Strike''''' - Increase the production of all buildings. The more spell casts, the more production is increased. See [[Spells#The Spells|table of increase/casts]].<br />{{Formula|stat|30\times x^{0.9}%|Combo Strike casts (This game)}}  
* '''[[Spells#Spell Upgrades|Spell Upgrade]]''': '''''Perfect Combo''''' - Increases ''Combo Strike'' bonus.<br />{{Formula|stat|40\times x^{0.9}%|Combo Strike casts (This game)}}  
** Unlock requirement: Cast ''Combo Strike'' 100 times in a row.  
* '''[[Heritage]]''':  Increase the production of assistants based on the amount of Royal Exchanges you purchased in this game.<br />{{Formula|stat|2 \times x^{0.8}|your Royal Exchanges made (This Game)}}
* '''[[Bloodline]]''': Multiplicatively increase the chance to find Faction Coins based on time spent in this game.<br />{{Formula|stat|1.6 \times x^{0.6}|time spent (this game)}}
* '''[[Challenge|Challenge Reward]]''': '''''Versatile Combo''''' - Increase Combo Strike counter based on the amount of spells cast in this game, excluding Tax Collection.<br />{{Formula|xy|10 \times \log_{10}(1 + (y \times 30)) + x|Combo Strike casts (This game)|every other spell's (except [[Tax Collection|TC]]) casts (This game)}}
* '''[[Unique Building]]''':  '''''Spider Sanctuary''''' (from Dark Temples)  
* '''[[Research|Research Facilities]]''': '''''Spellcraft, Alchemy, Warfare'''''
* '''Faction Unlock Requirements''': See [[Drow#Faction Unlock Requirements|below]]

== Drow Research  ==
[[File:R29-Prestige-research-msg.png|right|300px]]
Upon reaching R29, the game advisor tells us that the Prestige factions have discovered an almost infinite source of magical power: Prestige Research.

Drow [[Research]] enables you to combine both unique buildings and researches from both the Vanilla and Drow factions.

Each item below can be unlocked in separate game plays, and most only need to be bought once throughout the entire game play. The Unique building upgrade and the ''Dark Light of Bondelnar'' are the only ones that need to be bought each run and count towards the 'Bought Upgrades' [[stats]].{{clr}}

<u>To Unlock Prestige Research:</u>
# Uncover the [[Artifacts|''Earth Core'' Artifact]] with any Faction, and gather enough gems to be able to buy the Secrets of the Underworld ({{Number|1e200}} coins and {{Number|1e7}} FCs)
# When ready, play a [[Vanilla faction]] (Good Faction for Dwarf, Evil for Drow). Choose one that will be able to afford the Secrets of the Underworld. Do not buy the Vanilla faction's Unique building upgrade until you have bought the prestige [[Trade Treaty]].
# Once affiliated with the prestige faction, buy their Unique building quest, Unique Building upgrade, and then the Secrets of the Underworld. With the latter, the research button and prestige research will show up.
After you have unlocked Prestige research, the Vanilla unique building and Vanilla researches can be acquired before purchasing the prestige trade treaty. Plan in advance to not use up all your RUS on Vanilla researches, as prestige researches only show up after you affiliate with a prestige faction.
